ledger.x: 1 December 1918: the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes is established.
ledger.cpn: Serbia (Revolutionary Serbia, Principality and Kingdom of Serbia)

ledger.x: 1919: the dispute over south-eastern Carinthia begins.
10 September 1919: the Treaty of Saint-Germain gives 'a portion of the Alpine provinces to the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes'.
27 November 1919: the Treaty of Neuilly gives the kingdom a strip of Bulgaria.
4 June 1920: Trianon confirms the north and east.
10 October 1920: the Carinthian plebiscite keeps the south-east in Austria.
12 November 1920: the Treaty of Rapallo gives Italy Zadar and islands.
3 October 1929: the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes becomes the Kingdom of Yugoslavia.
1941: Montenegro passes to Italy.
1941: Italy annexes land on the Adriatic.
1941: Kosovo passes to Italian-ruled Albania.
April 1941: Hungary occupies and annexes the north-east.
6 April 1941: the Axis invades Yugoslavia.
10 April 1941: the Independent State of Croatia is proclaimed.
17 April 1941: Yugoslavia capitulates.
19 April 1941: Bulgaria enters Macedonia and eastern Serbia.
April 1941: Serbia passes to German military rule.
ledger.cpn: Territory of the Military Commander in Serbia

ledger.x: April 1941: Germany takes northern Slovenia.
29 November 1943: the Partisans' AVNOJ creates Democratic Federal Yugoslavia.
1944: Bulgaria leaves Macedonia and eastern Serbia.
20 October 1944: Belgrade is liberated and again the seat.
1945: the Independent State of Croatia is overrun.
1945: the German occupation of northern Slovenia ends.
1945: the Ljubljana Province and the Bay of Kotor return from German hands; the Italian-annexed lands had passed from Italy to Germany in September 1943.
1945: Medjimurje and Prekmurje return.
March 1945: the Partisan movement and the exile government form one government.
May 1945: the Yugoslav army occupies the Julian March.

29 November 1945: the monarchy is abolished and the occupation passes to the Federal People's Republic, so this end only closes the pair for this dossier; the occupation itself lasts until the 1947 peace treaty took effect.
29 November 1945: the monarchy is abolished and the Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia is proclaimed.

wars.name: Invasion of Yugoslavia
wars.outcome: Yugoslavia invaded on 6 April 1941 and capitulated on 17 April; the Independent State of Croatia was proclaimed on 10 April, Hungary, Italy and Bulgaria annexed or occupied the periphery and Germany occupied Serbia and northern Slovenia; the king left for…

wars.name: Yugoslav resistance and liberation
wars.outcome: The Partisans controlled the eastern half of the country by late 1944; the Red Army took Belgrade on 20 October 1944; the German withdrawal from Sarajevo on 15 April 1945; a coalition government on 7-8 March 1945; the monarchy abolished on 29 November 1945.

certainty.note: The kingdom was established on 1 December 1918 with unsettled frontiers in Carinthia, Banat and the Adriatic.
Trianon (1920), Neuilly (1919) and Rapallo (12 November 1920) fixed the frontiers; the Carinthian plebiscite of 1920 left the south-east of Carinthia in Austria.
Annexation and occupation lines of the Axis partition are not on the pages opened.
Istria, Rijeka, Zadar and the Julian March were still undecided until the 1947 Paris treaty.
